Name: BigBubbleMoveLimitter
Notes: An object that limits the movement of a player within a BigBubble assigned to it via a BigBubbleGenerator.

Obj_arg0.Name: Move Limitter ID
Obj_arg0.Description: ID of the BigBubbleMoveLimitter associated with generated bubbles. Nonexistent generators crash the game.

Obj_arg1.Name: Bubble Range
Obj_arg1.Description: Range from center axis of limiter. Only useful on BigBubbleMoveLimitterCylinder. Will pull the bubble back towards the center if possible.
